Subject: Follow-up & logs from today's demo

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great overview. We spun up a quick POC to test the SDK tool-calling + embeddings reranker flow you showed. On our end we hit intermittent 5xx errors when the pipeline hits the first tool call followed by an embeddings batch: typically a 502 or a 504 within 10-20s.

Attached are two files: stream.log (server-side log capture) and repro_payload.json (the request payload we used). The payload includes a nested tool call + structured output schema and an embeddings batch of 16 vectors.

Questions:
- Is there a recommended timeout or chunking approach for tool-calls + embeddings in the same request?
- Could this be an auth/routing mismatch between your hosted model variant and our region?

Would appreciate a short triage so we can get past this blocker before our internal stakeholders sign off. We can give you access to additional logs if helpful.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director, Platform Engineering
NovaHealth (NovaProspect)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up & logs from today's demo — initial triage notes

I pulled the repro_payload.json into a local staging cluster (SDK v1.6.2, same model family). Quick notes:
- Reproduced a 502 when the tool returned a ~7k token structured result before embeddings were requested. The stack trace points to a kernel selection timeout in the runtime (the request waits while the allocator picks quantized kernels for the long sequence).
- Workaround that avoided the 502: set stream=false and split the tool call so the embeddings request is a separate follow-up call (i.e., two requests instead of one).
- Short-term config that lowered failures: request_timeout_ms -> 30000, embedding_batch_size -> 8, enable_continuous_batching -> true.

I'll attach a tiny repro_script.sh that automates the broken payload and the split-payload workaround. Send me the failing request ID (or the exact timestamp) and I'll correlate traces from staging to hosted logs.

Plan: if Oliver confirms the reproduction, we'll run a controlled replay on a cloned pool, capture KV cache / kernel selection traces, and decide whether a runtime patch or SDK guidance is required.

Attaching repro_script.sh.

- Priyom
Staff Software Engineer, Inference Runtime

- If it's KV cache pressure, we'll provide explicit guidance on KV cache sizing and a small runtime patch to improve eviction heuristics.
